tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen dril bu lugs kyi phyi rdul tshon gyi cho ga'i mngon dkyil gnyis lhan cig tu bkod pa nges don gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu rush+tsa dai ye tsakra sam+bha ra ya/ spros dang bral yang spros pa cir yang ston/ /bde mchog brnyes kyang lha mo'i bde bar rol/ /rtag chad spangs kyang rtag tu gzhan don mdzad/ /mchog gi bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog rgyal/ /oṃ ḍi bi sha'i bas mtha'i nags khrod du/ /grub gnyis mngon gyur gdug can rgyal po btul/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /grub ba'i dbang phyug gang des ring du skyongs/ /mgon de'i bzhed pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs/ /nges brjod rgyud kyi zab don mthar thug pa/ /'phags pa'i yul nas ljongs 'dir dar ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga gzhan la phan phyir 'bri/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon la/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i slob ma yis/ /bdag gzhan yongs su smin bya'i phyir/ /rjes su gzung bar gsol btab nas/ /de yi cho ga brtsam par bya/ /bsnyen pa sa chog sta gon dang / /bri zhing rgyan dgram sgrub cing mchod/ /slob dpon slob ma 'jug pa dang / /mjug gi cho ga ces bya las/ /dang po gnyis ni shar chen sogs/ /gong ma'i yi ge las 'byung ba'i/ /don bzhin shes bya sta gon la/ /gong du dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i bar/ /chag chag byi dor rgyan gyis mdzes/ /ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gis/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i gzhi byugs la/ /thig chen brgyad dam dkyil 'khor gyi/ /skya thig yongs rdzogs gdab bya ste/ /de yang rtsig pa phan chad ni/ /kyai rdo rje ji bzhin la/ /nang du lha snam sgo tshad gcig /de dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /mu khyud gri gug phreng bas bskor/ /dbus su dri bzang thig le ni/ /gru bzhi phyogs mtshams brgyad rnams su/ /zlum steng me tog tshom bu bkod/ /phyogs bzhi shar nub lhag bcas pa'i/

/spos dang mar me zhal zas ni/ /g.yon bskor dag tu legs par bsham/ /dkyil 'khor lhor bstan dbang byas nas/ dkyil 'khor shar lho 'jig rten pa'i/ /lho nub nas brtsams g.yon skor du/ /mtshams 'dzin mchod yon zhabs bsil dang / /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas la sogs mchod pa bsham/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni nye ba'i sar/ /yi dam chos skyong la sogs pa'i/ /bris 'bur sku yi drung dag tu/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /gtor ma lnga bdun la sogs pa/ /rang rang bla ma'i phyag len bzhin/ /mchod dang bcas te legs par bsham/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bum pa ni/ /drug gam yang na gnyis pa la/ /bgegs bskrad nang rdzas chab kyis bkang / /ras kyi mgul chings ku shas brgyan/ /pad nyi la gnas rdo rje sngo/ /pad zla la gnas gri gug bzhi/ /rnam rgyal bum pa la btags shing / /so sor yod na gri gug bzhi/ /lha mo rnams kyi bum par btags/ /pad zlar gnas pa'i gri gug ni/ /dmar po las bum rgyan du'o/ /dung chos rdor gzungs me tog phreng / /rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru/ /me tog snod dang gos zung sogs/ /'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad dang / /slob ma rjes su gzung dgos na/ /de yi chas bcas legs par bsham/ /zhes pas rtogs par byas nas/ dngos gzhi la sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor la/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ tri sh+ya hoḥ zhes pas mgron spyan drangs/ pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsi/ un man da/ a pa smā rā/ ḍā ka ḍā ki

n+yi da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ/ gh+rih+nan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai waṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhu dza tha/ pi ba thā/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mi ta pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ā ka ra ta ya sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa ha yi ga bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pad+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ ghan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang / mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu chig rdung ngos/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams༞ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams༞ /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams༞ /smyo byed tshogs rnams༞ /brjed byed tshogs rnams༞ /mkha' 'gro tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad kun/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhesaparnams/ /dpal chen bka' bstod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pa'i/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ dril bu gsum brdung gi rjes su rgyun chags dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang /

bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung zhing dngos grub sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ rdo rje sa la reg pa'i stongs ka dang / gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi brjod cing gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ yang gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar dharma ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du bde mchog lha lnga bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i rgyab khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri lta bur brtsigs par mos la/ de'i gtso bo bla ma dang sangs rgyas/ chos po ti chos/

mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dge 'dun dkon mchog tu mos pa'i drung du rang gzhan thams cad 'khod de 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyis kun nas blangs pa'i byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum sogs skyabs 'gro spyi 'gre lan gang mang / bla ma dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pas/ 'khor 'od dkar pos dpral bar thim/ chos 'od dmar pos mgrin par thim/ gtso bo 'od sngon pos snying gar thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas ma rgyud spyi 'gre ltar byas la/ bdud rtsi ril bu khar myang ba'am/ med na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa myang la/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ lan gsum/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni nang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /don de dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/

ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa ra bh+yaḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig 'od zer las sprul pa'i/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos dbyings ma/ /dkar sngo ser dmar ljang khu dkar mo rnams/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /me long pi waṃ dri bzang zhal zas dang / /na bza' chos 'byung 'dzin zhing 'og ma gnyis/ /g.yas pas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon pa yis/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin cing lang tshor ldan/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas brgyan/ /dpag med rab bsngags brjod cing mgon sogs mchod/ /zhes dang / pad kor sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya 'og mchod phreng nas 'byung ba ltar bcas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba wī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra a dar+sha badz+ri ni badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du gong 'og 'dra ba las/ wī ni badz+ri ni/ gan+dhe badz+ri ni/ ra sa badz+ri ni/ par+she badz+ri ni/ dharmā dha dhu badz+ri ni badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas phyi mchod dang / yang / mkha' 'gro ma dang la ma dum skyes ma/ /gzugs can ma rnams sngo ljang dmar ser mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /bdud rtsi rnam lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /'og ma thod ḍā thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'chang / /rgyan dang na bzas spras pa dpag med spros/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zag med bdud rtsis mchod/ /oṃ sarba nas/ sarba wī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod la mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni nang mchod/

yum rdo rje phag mo dang snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs nas/ sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥ badz+ra ma hā su kha hūm̐/ zhes dang / pad kor sngon 'gro'i 'khyud rgya bya ba ni gsang mchod do/ /de nas thal mo sbyar la/ deng nas byang chub snying por ma mchis bar/ /rin chen dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sngar byas sdig pa bshags shing slar yang sdom/ /'khor dang 'das pa'i dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag par bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /sems can don du byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /bsam sbyor phun tshogs smon 'jug sems gnyis bskyed/ /dge des bdag gzhan he ru kar gyur cig /lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang gi sems su shes par byas te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shūd+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shūd+dho3haṃ/ sems de yang rang bzhin ci yang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad lha lnga'i skur gyur pa tshur 'dus nas gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ lha rnams rang la thim/ rang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ de'ang mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du rang he ru ka sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ shar nas brtsams te phyogs g.yon bskor dang /

me nas brtsams te mtshams g.yas bskor du sdigs mdzub se gol dang bcas pas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gnyis brjod phyogs mtshams de dag tu sngags kyi yig 'bru kha dog dmar po 'bar ba dang bcas pa rang gi zhal nas 'phros pas de dag las steng dang shar du kha gdong ma re re/ byang du 'ug gdong ma/ nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma re re/ lhor phag gdong ma/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba mo/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs shing / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa drag mo shin tu khros pa'i gzugs can rnams kyis g.yas tho ba dang / g.yon phur bu 'dzin pas bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad/ slar yang sngags kyi 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje las 'phros pa'i 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i drwa bas yongs su gtams par gyur/ g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ me di ni badz+ri bhā wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi dha na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ sā ra dza la traṃ saṃ praṃ/ so so lan gsum gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ pho nya rnams las 'od zer lcag kyu lta bu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad bkug nas rang gi mdun du hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i dong gru gsum pa'i nang du bcug par gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod a dz+nyā pa ya ti ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsgos pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ g.yon khu tshur gyi steng g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum gdab pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra murka ra badz+ra kī la ya a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje tho bas phur bu'i spyi bo nas brdungs te bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug ste rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du bskyal nas pho nya rnams 'od du zhu ba mda'i drwa ba la thim pa'i 'od zer gyis de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i rwa ba/ de las 'phros pa'i pad+ma'i rwa ba/ de las 'phros pa'i 'khor lo'i rwa ba zlum po gsum gyi phyi rol du ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma pra ka ra hūm̐/ oṃ tsakra pra ka ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs so/ /de lta bu'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser gyi rang bzhin las grub pa/ gru bzhi bang rim bzhi lcogs brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin/

dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang / sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la steng nas do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang / mda' yab dang pu shu ba dan bcu gnyis kyis mdzes par byas la/ rtsig pa'i 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bskor ba/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams rnams su zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje rin po ches spras pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rnga yab la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du drag tu gtum pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ mer nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ bden bral du mun pa mi bzad pa/ rlung du kī li kī li'i sgra sgrog pa/ dbang ldan du ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ rim pa de nyid kyi brgya byin/ gnod sbyin/ chu lha/ gshin rje/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te phyogs skyong brgyad dang / shi ri sha a shwa ta/ kaṃ ka la/ tsu ta/ ka ran+dza/ larta pra ka ti/ pa ti pa tra/ bha dra ste shing brgyad dang / de rnams kyi yal ga'i gseb tu sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag gtum skyong ba la sogs pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad dang / nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/ pad+ma/ hu lun+ta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong /

pad+ma chen po ste klu brgyad dang / sgra grags pa/ rmugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun tu 'khyil ba/ gang ba/ 'bab pa/ drag po/ 'khrigs pa ste sprin brgyad dang / gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / ro dang / ro langs dang / sha za dang / 'byung po dang / ce spyang dang / khwa 'ug la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i grwa bzhir dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gi drwa bas bskor ba'i lte bar 'jig byed dang dus mtshan brtsegs pa'i snying khar nyi ma'i gdan/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ro'i snying khar zla ba'i gdan/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la zla ba'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i phreng ba lta bus/ a ā nas/ aṃ aḥ'i bar tshar gnyis brjod la zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga nas/ ya ra la wa ḍa dha'i bar lan gnyis brjod la zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang / de'i g.yon du baṃ las gri gug baṃ gyis mtshan pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/

rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon dmar/ g.yas ser/ steng zhal ljang ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa spu phyir bstan nas mgo g.yas su 'phyang ba'i rkang lag nas sdigs mdzub dang bcas smin mtshams kyi thad du 'phyar nas bzung zhing lding stabs su gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra satwa/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor lcogs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches spras shing / g.yon phyogs su tshes gcig gi zla ba dang / mtshog ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yi/ /gar gu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /spyi bor rigs bdag gi cod pan 'dzin zhing steng du gdugs dkar pos brgyan pa'o/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa rgyu ma dang khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing /

skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ brla gnyis la hā ljang khu/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa rgya mtsho las byung ba'i ze 'bru dkar po byeṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse gcig pa byeṃ las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po byeṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam par spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa thig le bzhir gyur/ de rnams maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ zhes pa'i sa bon bzhir gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu lha mo bzhir gyur nas yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'thon te gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du la ma ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni la ma/ chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dum skyes ma/ sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can ma/

yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos lhag ma rnams ni gtso bo yab yum gyi ngo bor dag la/ lha lnga yang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos kyi ngo bor rnam par dag go /lha thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du yab kyi snying khar/ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis la bau ṣaṭa he nag po he ru ka mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog dang / yab yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo ste yab kyi gnas su yum dang / yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur/ rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan/ gung mtheb gnyis so sor lto sbyar/ mdzub mo gnyis lu gu brgyud du sbrel/ sor mo lhag ma rnams brkyangs pa'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon bskor du bskor la gdong bsgyur/ mig gyen du lta ba dang bcas/ phaiṃ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis phyir 'brangs kyi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hās mchod yon dang / tshogs zhing gi skabs kyi lha mo drug gi sngags kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

gnyis su med par thim/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shūd+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shūd+dho3haṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod la/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis mchod/ khro bo khro mos bgegs bskrad/ yum bzhi phag mo dang lngas bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba thogs nas dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab la rdo rje sems dpa'/ yum la mi bskyod pa/ mkha' 'gro ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ la ma la don yod grub pa/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig 'od zer las byung ba'i zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas phyi mchod dang / mdun gyi thod chang khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi dbus su a las pad+ma'i snod dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ shar du oṃ las dri chen/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems/

lhor trāṃ las rak+ṣa/ shar lhor laṃ las ba lang gi sha lho nub tu maṃ las khyi'i sha nub byang du paṃ las rta'i sha byang shar du taṃ las glang po che'i sha dbus su baṃ las mi'i sha rnams rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar thod pa bsros rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba las bdud rtsi kha dog dmar por gyur/ de'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po las kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ a ā nas/ aṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ka kha nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa rnams g.yas bskor g.yon bskor du 'dus pa las byung ba'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum brtsegs pa las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te yi ge gsum la thim/ de kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la thim/ de hūm̐ la thim/ de 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor la/ hūm̐ baṃ/ maṃ/ taṃ/ paṃ/ laṃ/ oṃ āḥpañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te zhes pa nas byeṃ gyis mtshan pa zhes pa yan gong bzhin la/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang / 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi re sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni pan+ni bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+ra ṭa mu ku ṭat+kā+o ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭa ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa na mu kha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha pra bhu dza bhā pu rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ byā gra dzi naṃ ba ra dha ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhum bran+ha ka ra wa pu ṣa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa yab kyi rkang pa brgyad pa dang / oṃ na mo bhā ga wā ti badz+ra wā ra hi baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya pa rā dzi te trai lokya ma te ma hā bi d+ya shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha ya bā he ma hā badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra sha ne a dzi te a pa ra dzi ta pa sham ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥbi ṣa ni sho ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka ra li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pan tra pa nā mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni pa ra dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi dza ye dzam+bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā ra he ma hā yo gi ni ka me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang brgyad de gnyis kyis bstod la/ lha mo rnams snying khar thim par bsam/ rang nyid lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa rten dang brten par bcas pa ci tsam gnas kyi bar du sems bzung zhing / bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng byung / rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs yum gyi zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim zhes brjod cing sngags phreng rgyun mi chad pa la sems gtad la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha raṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes yab yum gyi snying po gnyis brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa dang / oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes nye snying gnyis dang / oṃ ḍā ki ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ la ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ru pi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lha mo bzhi'i sngags rnams ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad la thim/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor dang bum thod bzhi la thim/ de rnams rang la thim/ yum yab la thim/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim pas/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i sku can du gyur/ sa lha'i sgos mchod spos mar me sbar/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ tshom bu la dmigs te/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī/ skad cig gis tshom bu'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ dar dkar po'i na bza' can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lag pa g.yas brkyangs la rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ nas shap+ta'i mthar rol chen dharmā ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ rdor dril spos 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor 'dri/ /lan gsum gyi mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ hūm̐ yig 'bar ba 'phros pas sa 'og gi bar rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa hūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa r+dha tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor khaṇ+ḍa ro hi bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkhar chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/

byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i drwa ba dang / ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza ra traṃ paṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gsum brjod cing sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bstan pa'i srung 'khor bsgom/ de lta bu'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa nas/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang zhes pa'i bdag bskyed bzhin dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ de dag gi rgyab brten pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ 'og gi rgya mtsho la gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ zhes pa nas phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ro'i snying khar zla ba'i gdan/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la zla ba'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī sogs lan gsum/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye sogs/ oṃ ma ma ye sogs/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sogs/ oṃ ru pi ṇi ye lan gsum gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bcu gnyis brjod la tshom bu so so la dmigs pa gtad/ tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog zhes pa nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo nas/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i bar/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la zla ba'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'o/

/lha thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du nas/ yum rnams kyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas nas/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bar brjod/ de nas mchod pa'i thog mar sngags mchod ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī ri sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nas/ ka me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar dang / oṃ shrī badz+ra sogs nas ru pi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar tshar gcig brjod/ mchod pa rnams khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing che ba nas/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba wi ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya se gol dang bcas pas phul/ de bzhin du gong 'og thams cad 'dra ba las/ mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bcug pa dang / ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs bcug la phul ba'i mthar rol chen/ gzugs kyi lha mo dkar mo zla ba'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dar dang rin chen brgyan/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis me long thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yas 'og ḍā ma ru dang g.yon pa yis/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin cing lang tshor ldan/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthar thug pa/ /bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra nas/ a dar+sha badz+ri ni badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i g.yas kyi thal mo gyen du bslang ba'i mkhrig mar g.yon gyi khu tshur bzhag pa me long gi phyag rgya bya/

sgra yi lha mo sngon mo dbang sngon mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi༞ /dang po'i phyag gnyis snyan pa'i pi waṃ sgrengs/ /g.yas 'og ḍā ma ru dang༞ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin cing༞ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang༞ /a dar+sha'i gnas su wī ni badz+ri ni zhes dang / pi waṃ bsgyur ba'i tshul bya/ dri yi lha mo ser mo gser gyi mdog /zhal gcig sogs/ dang po'i phyag gnyis dri bzang dung chos 'dzin/ /g.yas 'og sogs wi ni'i gnas su gan+de badz+ri ni/ dri'i phyag rgya bya/ ro yi lha mo dmar mo byu ru'i mdog /zhal gcig sogs༞ dang po'i phyag gnyis ro brgya'i zhal zas bsnams/ /g.yas 'og sogs nas/ ra sa badz+ri ni zhes dang / zhal zas kyi phyag rgya bya/ reg bya'i lha mo ljang khu margad mdog /zhal gcig sogs/ dang po'i phyag gnyis lha rdzas na bza' 'dzin/ /g.yas 'og sogs nas/ par+she badz+ri ni zhes dang / gos zung 'bul tshul bya/ chos kyi lha mo dkar mo chu shel mdog /zhal gcig sogs/ dang po'i phyag gnyis bha ga'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin/ /g.yas 'og sogs nas/ dharmā dha tu badz+ri ni zhes dang / thal mo sbyar ba las mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas 'bul ba ni phyi mchod do/ /thod chang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang / swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar/ nang mchod kyi dbus nas mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ma dang la ma dum skyes ma/ /zhes pa nas/ rgyan dang na bzas spras pa dpag med spros/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin ngo bo/ /mkhyen brtse nus gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/

/rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /grub chen dril bu pa dang tai lo pa/ /nā ro pa dang pham mthing sku mched zhabs/ /klog skya lo tsā'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /bla chen mal lo brtse chen snying po'i mtshan/ /bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che/ /bsod nams seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po rin chen grub/ /rin chen rnam rgyal kun dga' rin chen mtshan/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan bsod nams bzang po'i zhabs/ /kun dga' rnam rgyal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /yon tan rgya mtsho shākya kun dga' dang / /dbang phyug rgyal mtshan tshul khrims bkra shis mtshan/ rin chen rgyal mtsho phrin las rnam rgyal ba/ /blo gros dbang phyug zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /theg chen gling pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / /he ru ka dpal ngur smrig bla gos can/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bsod nams blo gros sogs/ rin chen seng ge bu ston rin chen grub/ /khyung lhas pa dang nor bzang rin rgyal mtshan/ /mkhyen rab chos rje mkhan chen rgya mtsho ba/ /kun dga' don grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / /chos bzang rin rgyal bsod nams mchog grub zhabs/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer rin chen brtson 'grus dang / /yon tan dar rgyas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /blo bzang rgyal mtshan blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / /blo bzang yon tan zhwa lu rin chen grub/ /ngag dbang bzang po rdo rje rin chen sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ baṃ maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes dang / rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams rnams su thig le byas pas nang gi lha tshim par bsam/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ tsa turmu kha/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra ru tra/ bha ṭa/ ru lu/ k+ṣi si/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+do dang nye ba'i tshan+do/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes rang gi lce thog tu myangs/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sogs nas/ sa pa ri wa ra sogs oṃ āḥbadz+ra ma hā su kha hūm̐/

pad kor sngon 'gro'i 'khyud rgya/ ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas yab yum gyi rkang brgyad brjod/ hūm̐ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs chen po/ /rgyu ma'i me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /khrag 'thung dpal la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lhag pa'i lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med dbang phyug sku dang gnyis med cing / /bde chen 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas sku yi sprin 'phro ba/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku/ /'khor sa stongs par mdzad pa'i thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul ba la/ yang na bum bskyed kyi rjes la phul kyang rung / snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ rang gi lce rdo rje'i sbu gur bsam la/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bor khrag 'thung dpal/ /phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma la ni phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag bdag gis ni/ /nangs par dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bgyi/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te/

/kun gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lan gsum gyi mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nas/ 'tshal na zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ sang 'dir byon nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ skabs 'dir mjug chog bya ba'am/ yang na gtor bsngo'i rjes la byas kyang rung / ༈ bum pa sta gon ni/ gong du bshams pa'i bum pa khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gi rwa bas bskor ba'i lte bar 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan brtsegs pa'i snying khar nyi ma'i gdan phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ro'i snying khar zla ba'i gdan/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la zla ba'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ las thams cad kyi bum par sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar ro'i snying khar zla ba'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo zhes pa nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ dbus kyi nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang / de'i g.yon du baṃ las gri gug baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ phyogs bzhi'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ rnams las byung ba'i gri gug maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa/

las thams cad kyi bum pa'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du paṃ las gri gug dmar po baṃ gyis mtshan pa rnams so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes gyis me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du la ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ las thams cad kyi bum par khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhes pa nas/ g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar/ lha de thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du zhes pa nas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ dpal bde mchog lha lnga khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs sbyar nas/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan zhes pa'i bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin la/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra zhes sogs re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i nyer mchod rol chen dang bcas pa dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ baṃ maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ saṃ/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pas yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod la/ pad kor dang bcas pas gzungs thag blangs nas rang gi zhal nas sngags kyi 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas lha rnams kyi sku la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru sogs brgya rtsa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī sogs/ oṃ ḍā ki nī sogs lha mo bzhi'i sngags dang thod pa bzhi la 'bru gsum lan gsum gsum las bum la khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ji ltar rigs pa/ thun mong du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi mthar pad kor dang bcas pas dung chos kyi mchod yon phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu nas ye shes kyi chur gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas dgos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod la/ gong du gtor ma 'bul ma tshar na skabs 'dir 'bul ba yin pas/ gtor ma khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zhes pa nas de hūm̐ la thim/ de 'og gi gtor ma la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim zhing / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mtha' bskor du bzhugs par gyur/ de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / pad kor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ/ tri sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun gyis phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i mthar rol chen/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ baṃ laṃ taṃ paṃ maṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /rol chen dang bcas pas yab yum gyi rkang brgyad gnyis kyi mthar/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa bcom/ /khyod kyi dngos po thams cad mkha' ltar mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan/ /mgon po thugs rje'i char gyis yang dag brlan pa thugs kyi chus/ /lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu dgyes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /de nas kyai rdor bde mchog lū nag sogs yi dam dang / gur zhal sogs rang gi thugs dam chags med gang yin la gtor ma phul nas/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor phul ba'i mthar/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod la/ de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma phul/ bskang ba byed par spro na so so'i lag len bya'o/ /mjug chog ni mchod pa kha gsos la/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs mchod 'phreng bzhin dang / bum bskyed bzhin gyis mchod pa phul ba'i rjes su/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ri hūm̐ sogs lha mo drug dang / nang mchod kyi rjes su 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ma hā su kha hūm̐/ zhes pas gsang mchod dang /

rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang / gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rdo rje'i khu tshur las mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad de brkyangs pa spyi bor ldog pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ bshad ma thag pa ltar mchod bstod byas la rten yod pa la brtan bzhugs/ med pa la gshegs gsol bya'o/ /go bgo ba ni/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug du swā hā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po he ru ka mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa ha ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags lan gnyis brjod la/ phyogs g.yon bskor dang mtshams g.yas bskor du sdigs mdzub bstan la bar chad bsrung / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'khor lo bde mchog 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'og nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis bya'o/ /de nas slob ma sta gon bya dgos na skabs 'dir logs nas 'byung ba'i mtshams sbyar bzhin bya/ thig tshon byin rlabs ni/ stegs ji ltar rigs pa la rin po che'i snod du tshon sngon po la hūm̐/

shar du dkar po la oṃ/ lhor ser po la trāṃ/ nub tu dmar po la oṃ/ byang du ljang khu la khaṃ rnams 'bri ba dang / 'og bden stobs brjod pa'i skabs su rigs lnga'i sa bon shul du hi 'bri bar bshad pa yang 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir skabs 'dir sa bon gyi drung du hi re bri/ rigs lnga'i sa bon phyis nas hi rnams bden stobs kyi bar ma phyis na lag len bde ba lags/ de rnams kyi steng du so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud gsar pa sboms su sgo'i nyi shu'i cha dang / ring thung dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur gyi tshad yod pa rnams bzhag de dag gi mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod dang gtor ma bsham/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas thig tshon khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lnga'i dbus dang phyogs gzhan rnams su nyi ma/ shar du zla ba/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing mā ma kī dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dkar po oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin cing sangs rgyas spyan ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba ser po trāṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka sku mdog ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin zhing rin chen sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dmar po oṃ las 'od dpag med he ru ka sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin zhing gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ ljang khu khaṃ las don yod grub pa he ru ka sku mdog ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rigs lnga rnams spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/

rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing g.yas brkyangs pas bzhugs pa/ yum rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur 'phyang ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ye shes kyi thig tshon lnga 'od zer 'phros pa dang bcas par gyur ces brjod la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ āḥpra yats+tsha shā shwa ra pū tra swa tsakra pu tra ṇa ya hūm̐/ de bzhin du shā shwa ra'i gnas su rat+na saṃ bha wa dang / a mi ta bha wa dang / a mo gha sid+dhi dang / ak+ṣ+yo bh+yaḥrnams bcug la gsol ba btab/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i mig gnyis dzaḥlas skyes pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma ser por gyur/ zhes brjod la mig gi rdzi ma brdabs pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon byon te mdun gyi thig tshon gyi rigs lnga la thim par bsam/ oṃ dip+ta driṣ+ṭha aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod pa gzhan rnams kyis kyang mchod la mthar dril gsil bya/ hūm̐/ oṃ/ trāṃ/ aṃ/ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dang gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la thod pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ sa bon gyi mthar a kā ro btags pa gsum la sogs pas phul/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ zhes brjod la/ thig skud kyi rdo rje lag tu bzung nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas thig skud byin gyis brlabs/ yang g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis rigs lnga'i sa bon gyi rdul tshon rnams bsnur la/

oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa mā ya hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ hi'i yi ge rnams 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ zhes brjod la rdzi ma brdabs pa'i lta stangs dang bcas/ bden pa gang gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la rjes su chags par gyur pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig ces brjod/ thig skud rnams so sor brkyang la dum skyes ma'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma la gtad nas/ oṃ a n+yo3n+ya a nu ga taḥ sarba dharmā s+pha ra s+pha ra/ a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa/ sarba dharmā a t+yan+tā a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa/ sarba dharmā oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la las kyi rdo rjes/ dang po re re dang / de nas lhan cig tu sgril/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i lte ba la dkris la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor/ ye thig gdab pa ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du lta bas rdor dril dang bcas/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis lte ba'i thad du thig skud bzung / g.yas pas thig sna shar nas nub tu lta ba'i las kyi rdo rje la gtad dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod la las kyi rdo rjes kyang de bzhin du brjod la blangs/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis thig skud kyi dbus nas bzung ste steng nas gcus la 'og nas gyen du 'debs tshul bya zhing / sems can don du khyed rnams kyis/ /dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig /oṃ badz+ra su traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ 'debs pa'i go rim ni/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /rlung srin klu dbang me srin po/ /g.yas skor rgyab 'gros tshangs logs gdab/ /me rlung srin po dbang ldan nas/ rgyab 'gros spangs te zur thig gdab/ /gnyis bldabs dang po slob dpon dang / /phyi ma slob mar shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ thog mar mkha' thig de nas sa thig gdab pa'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs te thig la thim par bsam zhing /

dkyil 'khor du lam gyis grub par bsgom mo/ /de nas gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog ste/ oṃ badz+ra be ga mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes la ye thig nam mkhar btegs/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin la shar du lta bas rang gi mig gnyis su hi las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐ las khro bo'i rdo rjer gyur/ zhes brjod la smin ma g.yo ba dang bcas bzhi bca' pad kor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thugs ka dang / dril bu dkur brten la hi hiḥzhes brjod cing phyogs bzhir bltas pas mig gi rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros pas thar pa'i sgo'i gegs su gyur pa rnams bsal bar bsams la/ sgo bzhi'i rtsa thig g.yas g.yon dri bzang gi chus phyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su stan la 'dug kha shar du phyogs pas/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis tshon sngon po bkram la/ 'di ni chos dbyings rnam par dag /sems can thams cad rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo bde mchog rgyal chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor snying po 'bri bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra su traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod la dbang ldan gyi grwa nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du dkar ser dmar ljang nag po rnams phyi nas rim pa bzhin sgo tshad gcig gis bris la mchod pa lngas mchod/ thod pa la sogs pas kha bcad pa'i steng du thig skud rdo rje dang bcas pa bzhag rtsig pa sbrel ran pa dang tshon pra brtag go /de nas slob dpon gyi dang por dge zhes pa'i don yin/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi dbus nas rim pa bzhin 'bri bar bya ste/ de yang / sna tshogs pad+ma lte ba ljang / ge sar ser/ 'dab ma rnams phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ dbang ldan sngo/ bden bral ljang / phyi rol du gri gug gi phreng ba nag po phyir bstan g.yon bskor/ phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i grwa bzhir bum pa gnyis gnyis te brgyad kha rgyan dang bcas pa rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa phyed mda' yab pu shu/

sgo ka ba ka rgyan rta babs 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje nyi dkyil pad rwa dur khrod rdo rwa me ri rnams dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun no/ /mtshan ma 'god pa ni dbus su nyi dkyil la rdo rje rtse lnga sngon po/ phyogs bzhir zla ba la gri gug so phyir bstan re/ mtshams bzhir zla ba la bum thod bzhi dang bcas pa 'bri'o/ /bris zin pa dang thig skud dang rdul tshon lhag ma rnams la mchod de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ zhes brjod/ rgyan dgram pa ni/ spos rol mo dang bcas pas rnam rgyal bum pa slob dpon gyis thogs la g.yas skor lan gsum yig brgya 'don bzhin pa'i rjes su lha lnga'i sngags kyi mthar/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du bzhag yang las bum thogs la bskor ba gcig dang / khaṇ+ḍa ro hi brjod pa'i mthar dum skyes mas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod la byang shar du bzhag dkyil 'khor gyi mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i spyi mchod dang / lha so so'i sgos mchod bcas bsham/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / phyi rol gtor ma ni stegs kyi khar zlum gtor sha chang zas snas brgyan pa'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod nang mchod dang bcas pa bshams/ 'og tu dgos pa'i gos zung dbu rgyan sogs ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar sta gon bzhin/ de nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la las bum gyi chu dang dum skyes ma'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkhar chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du zhes pa nas gdan dang bcas par gyur/

zhes pa'i bar sta gon bzhin la/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo zhes pa nas/ laṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes zhes pa'i bar dang / go cha bgo ba'i bar (52) bum bskyed bzhin brjod la sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la bstim/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ bgegs bskrad mchod la bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas btab mchod bstod kyi bar sta gon bzhin byas la lha so so'i zhabs la 'jus par mos te/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brgya rtsa la sogs pa dang / gzhan rnams kyang ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar yig brgya nyer gcig la sogs pa brjod la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ sgrub grogs khaṇ+ḍa ro hi bzla zhing dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug rang nyid gong du bshad pa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma khyer la sgrub khang gi phyi'am/ dkyil 'khor yol bas mchod pa'i phyir song la sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin phrin bcol gyi bar brjod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas khu tshur snying khar/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la brkyangs la sarba bhu ta gats+tsha zhes pas gtor mgron gshegs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rang dang slob ma'i gnas gsum bsrung / gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i sogs sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod la rdor dril gsor dkrol dum skyes ma'i sngags bzla bzhin pas sgrub khang du log la/ rdo rje shugs kyis 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum bya ba'am/ mos pa byas la yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs lhag chad kha bskang ba mjug chog bzhin brjod pa'i rjes su sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin stsol cig

'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par mos la dbang gi cho ga rnams de'i zhal nas gsung par bsam zhing / ༈ rjes zlos rnams rang gis brjod pa'i mos pa dang / dbang rdzas 'grim pa gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phye ba'i he ru ka zhig gis mdzad par bsams la/ thog mar khrus kyi dod du las bum gyi chu cung zad 'thung la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ maṇ+ḍal la chu des thig le byas la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun la 'jug pa'i yon du phul/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /rdo rje 'chang chen ngo bo nyid/ /dmigs med bde chen ston pa po/ /slob dpon chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed pa'i nyon mongs bcom mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid bdag la grub par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rang 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can du gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs tshar gcig brjod la/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bcings/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba blangs/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i tshogs dpag tu med par spros te bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / las bum gyi chu gtor/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ /bde chen bdag nyid skal bzang la'o/ /de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/

oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi/ zhes dang / snying khar rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzhag la/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ ho/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar ma byed cig ma dad pa rnams la yang mi bya'o/ /zhes pa rnams kyi phyi'i 'jug pa dang / nang 'jug ni/ he ru ka'i phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs par bsams la/ de'i phyogs la mgo dud pa dang bcas/ hūm̐ dza hūm̐/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ thog mar shar sgo nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ dpral bar mgrin pa snying kha gsum du gtugs te/ rim pa bzhin/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥme hūm̐/ na maḥn maḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag 'tshal bar bsam/ yang rdo rje thal mo spyi bor sbyar la/ mkha' 'gro mas bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig snyam pas/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī pū dzo sas+d+yā nā ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī at+ma ḍā ki ni a dhi tiṣ+ṭhan+du maṃ/ zhes dang / yang 'dod snam nas g.yon skor gyis byang sgor zhugs te la mas bdag la dbang bskur cig snyam pas/ thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī pū dza a bhi ṣi kā ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī at+ma la ma a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ yang g.yon bskor gyis nub sgo nas/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his bdag la chos kyi 'khor lo skor cig snyam pas/ thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba wī ra yo gi nī pū dza pra warta na ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni at+ma khaṇ+ḍa ro hi pra warta ya maṃ/ yang g.yon bskor gyis lho sgor nas gzugs can mas bdag la 'phrin las mdzod cig snyam pas/

oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza karma ṇe at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni at+ma rū pi ni karma ku ru maṃ/ zhes pas phyag bya/ g.yon bskor gyis shar sgor 'khod pa la dri ba dris lan bya ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams kyi/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa na/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /zhes pa'i lan du/ tshig rkang sngon ma gsum 'dra ba la/ bdag ni rab tu 'tshal lags so/ /zhes lan btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyud bshad dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs kyis sdom pa bzung / dam la bzhag pa bzhi ni/ he ru kas rang gi lag pa g.yas nas bzung bar bsams la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di yi dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya'o/ /zhes phan yon dang / yang mgor rdo rje bzhag dril bu snying khar gsil la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje ste/ gal te khyod kyis tshul 'di 'ga' zhig la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gas par byed do/ /zhes nyes dmigs dang / yang snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la de ring yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes gnyis ka'i sgo nas dang / dri bzang gi chu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ byin gyis brlabs pa 'thung la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub 'grub/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes mna' chu byin pa'i sgo nas dang / yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/

deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces smra ba de bu khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar gyur ta re/ zhes bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag go /ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes sogs brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal ma gtogs gzhan rnams la'ang 'di kho na bzhin phul la tshig bsgyur dgos rnams bsgyur/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rang 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la ha/ snying gar laṃ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su hūm̐/ lte bar raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rno zhing 'bar ba la āḥ rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po chang zung thur du bstan zhing mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ dmar po/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos/ rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ mer 'bar/ long bu gnyis kyi rtsa nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa bo che na yar dmar khyug khyug song ba lte ba'i me dang 'dres/ drag tu 'bar pas snying kha'i sa bsregs/ spyi bo'i chu khol nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags pa snying kha'i sa la thim pas lus la bde drod dpag tu med pa skyes/

rkang 'og gi rlung gis yar btegs te/ bar snang du gnas pa la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i rnam par byon nas spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim pas lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu dkrol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha raṃ swā hā/ a be sha ya/ satwaṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ ha a dzhaiṃḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas la phebs pa'i rtags nges par byas nas/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes pas brtan par byas la/ he ru kas rang la dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo sprod pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /lha mo rnams kyi chos 'byung nyid/ /rin chen sna tshogs khang brtsegs ma/ /he ru ka dpal pho brang mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa mchog /bsod nams ji bzhin de bzhin shog /'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub pa/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ shar sgo nas nam mkha'i kha dog brtags la gang mthong ba de'i dngos grub 'grub par gsung bar bsam/ me tog 'bul ba ni/ lag tu bzung ba'i me tog trāṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i me tog tu mos la ltos pa med par phul bas/ gtso bo'i dbu thog tu babs par bsams la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod/ gtso bos rang gi spyi bor gnang bar bsams la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na satwaṃ/ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod/ mig gnyis su oṃ 'bar ba re re/ snying khar hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ/

hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bskul bas raṃ las me 'bar/ oṃ gyi 'od kyis gsal bar byas/ ma rig pa'i ling thog dang mig dar lhan cig tu bsal bar mos la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gdong g.yog bkrol nas/ oṃ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub phun tshogs khyod mngon gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad brkyang ba dang / /sngags 'di la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes brjod la/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo nas brtsams te/ gtso bo la thug gi bar bstan pa bzhin mthong bar bsam la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sku dang tsakli lta bu ma yin pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin no/ /zhes brjod/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ ji ltar sangs rgyas mkhas rnams kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag la mgon pos dbang bskur zhing / /mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/ /dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar du 'khor lo/ byang du ral gri/ nub tu pad+ma/ lhor rin po che/ dbus su shing stan la rang 'khor lo bde mchog gi nga rgyal gyis 'khod par gyur/ hūm̐ bzhi brjod pa'i yungs kar rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung la/

g.yas su lan gnyis g.yon du lan gnyis bskor zhing me dang chur dor la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ dri chab kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs/ bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang bcas hūm̐ zhes brjod/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin bshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de rnams kyis gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad dang / bum pa dkar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba thogs/ me tog gi char dbab cing / bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol bar bsams la/ rnam rgyal bum pa btegs rdor dril 'dzin pas/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs sh+lau ka gsum brjod pa'i mthar bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig mi bskyod pa chu dbang ni/ las bum gyi chu dang khaṇ+ḍa ro his rang dang rnam rgyal bum pa gnyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa ral pa'i thor cog dang / mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i pang na yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag dang dbang rdzas la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/

zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur bas yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyobs pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de ltar bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis glu len/ khro bo khro mos bgegs bskrad/ rig ma rnams kyis bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi chus gang bas dbang bskur/ zhes brjod la rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /zhes dang / ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bum chu 'thung zhes dbang bskur sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang lha gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon nas rang la thim/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid gnas 'gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang de'i rigs kyi phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang sku mdog dang rgyan cha lugs so so'i dbang rdzas rnams dgos chos rnams ma gtogs cho ga'i rigs 'gros 'dis shes (64) par byas la/ rin 'byung cod pan gyi dbang ni/

rang dang dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du trāṃ las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa zhes pa nas/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa'i bar gong dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas rin po che dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i pang na yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo sogs/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par sogs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur sogs/ rin chen can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /sogs kyi mthar dbu rgyan gon la/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang / yon tan dpag med 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid bzhin rin chen sna tshogs rgyal/ /ngo mtshar gzi brjid chen po'i mchog /cod pan gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na a bhi ṣe ka sogs/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa sogs/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rna ltag g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sogs/ gtso bo'i thugs ka sogs dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i sogs nas rang la thim/ mchod pas mchod/ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag nyon mongs can gyi yid gnas 'gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang de'i rigs kyi sogs brjod/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang ni/ rang dang rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du aṃ las pad+ma aṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med he ru ka sku mdog dmar po nas drug gis brgyan pa'i bar 'dra ba las g.yas pad+ma dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i pang na yum gos dkar mo sogs/ 'od dpag med kyi rnam par sogs/ zhu ba byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ pad+ma can gyi sangs rgyas la sogs kyi mthar/
