dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang / sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod ni dbang bskur bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu bsgrub phyir rdo rje longs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs brjod cing / lag pa g.yas kyis rdo rje gsum du reg oṃ badz+ri bha wa sogs nas/ yar lud pa las ltag par 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ gtso bo'i sogs dang 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i sogs nas rang la thim gyi bar mchod pas mchod/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas 'gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med dang de'i rigs kyi sogs/ don grub dril bu'i dbang ni/ rang dang dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du khaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje khaṃ gis mtshan pa las don yod grub pa he ru ka sku mdog ljang khu nas/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa'i bar/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i pang na yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu sogs nas don yod grub pa'i rnam par sogs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur sogs/ sna tshogs can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /sogs kyi mthar dril bu dkrol la/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang / /oṃ dril bu rdo rje rab ldan pa'i/ /shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur/ /rdo rje dam tshig gnas pa khyod/ /bdag pos dbang bskur rgyal nos shig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs brjod cing / rdor dril pad kor dang bcas pas 'khyud rgya bya/ badz+ri bhā wa nas yar lud pa las rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ gtso bo'i sogs dang / don yod grub pa gtso bor gyur pa'i nas rang la thim gyi bar mchod pas mchod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/

phrag dog dag sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don (67) yod grub pa dang de'i rigs kyi sogs brjod/ rnam snang ming dbang ni/ rang nyid bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dkar po nas/ drug gis brgyan pa'i bar/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i pang na yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo sogs nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'khor lo can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /sogs kyi mthar/ rdor dril lhan cig tu spyi bor dkrol/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang / oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bud+dha a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa nas/ yar lud pa las dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ gtso bo'i sogs dang / rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor gyur pa'i sogs nas/ rang la thim/ mchod pas mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad dang de'i rigs kyi sogs brjod/ dbang de dag gis ni ma rig pa la sogs pa lnga spangs shing / rig pa ye shes lnga skyed par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa rig pa'i lha mos dbang bskur bar byed pa'i phyir rig pa'i dbang zhes bya/ dbang de thob pas bya spyod kyi rgyud man chad nyan pa dang / 'chad pa dang / gsang sngags sgrub pa la dbang ba'i slob dpon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhes brjod/ bzlas lung gi dmigs pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung /

zhal nas thon/ rang 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas nas zhugs/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha raṃ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas la/ me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang / yang me tog mgor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la thal mo sbyar nas/ kye ho khyod kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /nus phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /snying rje'i gter gyis stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bde gshegs kun gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rdo rje mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po de 'od du zhu ba las rdo rjer gyur/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas sogs kyi mthar/ snying khar bzung la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/

/rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las aḥlas dril bu as mtshan pa las rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /dkrol la dku g.yon par kha gyen du phyogs pas bzung la/ aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /dam pa'i srid pa mdzad pa yin/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bzung la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/ /yid kyi lus ni brten bya'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces bshad de/ /gang gi lus kun brten byed pa/ /des na phyag rgya rab tu grags/ /zhes brjod/ de bstan pa'i phyir bum pa mgor bzhag la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /sogs kyi mthar/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams rang la thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/ mi mnyam med pas zur bzhi yin/ /bran dang dbang po sgo bzhi ste/ /rta babs bzhi ni bsam gtan yin/ /ting 'dzin kha khyer du ni brjod/ /kha khyer rdo rje rtses bstan pa'i/ /lha mo'i mchod pa bzung rnams su/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam spras pa/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed yin/ /sna tshogs rlung gis bskyod pa'i mchog

/ba dan dril bu'i sgra ldan pa/ /gdul bya sna tshogs kyis bskyod pa'i/ /chos kyi sgra mchog kun 'gro yin/ /me long me tog rtags ye shes/ /byang chub yan lag me tog phreng / /dngos grub thams cad mi 'gyur bde/ /bde ba chen po zhes brjod pa/ /nyi zla rin chen bskor ba yis/ /drwa ba drwa ba phyed pa yin/ /de yi nang gi 'khor lo ni/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad kyis mdzes pa ste/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyis 'dir/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba'o/ /bde gshegs kun gyis yongs gang ba'i/ /rdo rje'i skud pas bskor ba ni/ /byang chub sems kyi thig chen dang / /mdo sde'i 'khor lo bskor ba'o/ /tshon rnams sangs rgyas lnga 'di ni/ /ye shes sems can sems mchod pa'o/ /don dang dbang po rnam dag pas/ /rang gi mtshan nyid rab tu phye/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mngon gsol ba'i/ /rdo rje can gyi rdo rje'i 'od/ bum pa gang ba snying rje'i brlan/ /tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor me tog bdug pa dang / /mar me che dang dri rnams ni/ /byang chub yan lag yid 'ong tshims/ /chos kyi sgron ma grags 'dul yin/ /lha bshos chos kyi za ba ste/ /khrel yod ngo tsha'i sdom pa'o/ /glu dang gar dang rol mo sogs/ /bde ba chen po rnam par 'phel/ /thar pa mchog gi grong khyer mchog /snying po 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /zhes dang / lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shin tu rnam par dag pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni bcom ldan 'das he ru ka'o/ /lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang me long lta bu'i ye shes ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni la ma'o/ /chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni gzugs can ma'o/ /zhes brjod/

rjes su gnang ba la bzhi yod pa'i dang po lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ gar skor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas la rnam rol zhing / /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde bas mchod par gyis/ /aḥ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phangs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar gyis/ /de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar bya/ /gī/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byos/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /hoḥ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa'i/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyur/ /bh+rūṃ/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ hūm̐/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig ldongs pa las/ /ye shes sgron mes snang bar gyis/ /pra/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /gaḥ zhes brjod/ sems can don byed kyi rjes gnang ni/ rdo rjes mig 'byed tshul dang / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ me long len tshul dang / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung /

/rang bzhin med cing bdag med par/ /de ltar chos kun shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ /dril bu dkrol la/ aḥ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /gnas drug tu mda' 'phen pa'i tshul dang / hoḥ chos nyid gzhu la ye shes mda'/ /phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu 'phongs/ /bdud sogs bcom pas de bzhin gshegs/ /thams cad rjes su mnyes par gyis/ hoḥ zhes brjod/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ rkang 'og tu 'khor lo dang / lag pa g.yas su dung / g.yon du dril bu/ lag ngar du po ti byin par bsams la/ bh+rūṃ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ a oṃ badz+ra bha kha raṃ/ aḥ.aḥ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med par/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod tshul gyis cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas nas sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod/ rigs lnga sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ni/ so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bcug la brjod/ mthar/ de ltar na khyod kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams skor la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs bshad pa gyis shig ces brjod/ 'phrin las bzhi sgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/

zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang rengs sogs dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil l+h+wam de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de dag ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ zhes brjod pa ni rjes gnang ngo / /brtul zhugs la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po dang dril bu 'dzin pa pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ rdo rje blangs te/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /zhes dang / smin mtshams su lan gsum gsor la snying khar bzung / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka satwaṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa thul la rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs la gnas par gyis shig ces brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ rang skad cig gis pad nyi'i steng du 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi skur gyur zhes dang / lag pa g.yas su ḍā ma ru/ g.yon du thod pa/ gru mo g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga tshangs skud se ral khar bcings par bsams la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /thabs chen po ni blang bar gyis/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin/ /bde gshegs 'gro don la bskul ba/ /bu khyod kyis ni rtag tu zung / /mchod phyir thogs dang rnal 'byor snod/ /snying rje chen po bdud rtsi che/ /'gro ba thams cad skyong byed pa/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /zhes dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha sku bde ba chen po/ ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra/ thod pa bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa ste/

de dag dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces brjod la ḍā ma ru dkrol tshul dang bdud rtsi myong ngo / /lung bstan pa ni/ g.yon pa khu tshur gyis chos gos kyi grwa gnyis snying gar bzung / g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ 'dir ni khyod rnams ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams la ston/ /kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya satwaṃ/ bhur bhu baḥswaḥ gang la mtho ba'i phyag rgyas lung ston par byed pa'i de 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad de/ mtho ba'i phyag rgya 'di nyid kyi mthu dang / sngags 'di'i stobs yin no/ /zhes brjod/ dbugs dbyung ba ni/ da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bzhed pa yin/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de 'bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /zhes brjod/ gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /gnas par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can bcas pa/ /kun gyi tshe ldan de dbang bskur/ /khams gsum pa yi rgyal srid che/ /bdag po nyid du nges pa yin/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal nas/ /pho brang dam par zhugs pa yin/

/deng ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyod rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med dga' bar gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung bzhin du/ /khyod la sdig med ma 'jigs shig /ces brjod/ dam tshig la gnyis las/ dang po dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso bos rang gi lag pa nas bzung bar bsams la/ nangs par snga langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas su/ /bsrung dang bza' la sogs pa yi/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo / /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung / /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung bar bya/ /gnyis med gnyis med la gnas pas/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /thams cad gnyis med dpang na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /dam tshig rab bsrung bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba btab/ /bdag ni ma khyod bu yin pas/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod pa'i tshul/ /bslab pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas/ /nā da la sogs sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrungs/ /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid/ /spyod dang 'gro ba'i gnas 'dod pas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /gnyis pa spyod pa dang thun mong gi rjes gnang ni/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas/

/mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod pa rtag mnos la/ /'dod pa lnga la spyad par gyis/ /gnyis med la gnas zas la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brda/ /gnyis med pa dang thogs med pa/ /dam tshig spyad pa spyod pa yin/ /mi mo dbang phyug legs spyad pa'i/ /tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /khro ba med par rgyun bcad pa/ /sgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung / /yul kun la ni rnam rol zhing / /gnyis med sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mi brtan srog ni ji srid bar/ /bu khyod kyis ni sgrub par gyis/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci dga' bar ni longs spyod cig /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /bsams nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi gnas/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /dam pa'i chos ni smad mi bya/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid brtan par mi bya'o/ /rang gi bdag nyid dor nas ni/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde bar zung / /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes dang / 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bas/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ bde ba chen pos thig le la chags pa ste/ chags pa 'di bzhi dang bral ba las khams gsum na sdig che ba med pas/ khyod kyis de dag dang bral bar mi bya zhing / de dag la bslab par byos shig ces brjod/ de nas oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye sogs dang / de bzhin du oṃ ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ lā me/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ oṃ ru pi ni/

sogs tshar gcig brjod la/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon gang rung la bsrung ba'i gdu bus bcings/ mgo bor gdugs dkar po bzung dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ shar sgo nas lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag bya/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul bar bsams la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo dud pa dang bcas/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes brjod/ rang gi gral la 'khod par bsams la/ rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba dang / lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag 'bras bu sku rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ rig ma rgyan dang ldan pa phyag rgyar phul bar bsams la/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas/ skyabs med skyob pa skyob med skyabs/ /dpal ni 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che/ /mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi gtor/ bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ brla gnyis la hā ljang khu/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ d+yaṃ las byung ba'i ze 'bru dkar po d+yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/

yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse gcig pa/ byeṃ las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po byeṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs/ dbu gtsug nas zhugs thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu nas byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa dbu gtsug nas bzung ste dga' ba bzhi'i rim pa mngon du byas/ nor bu'i rtser lhan cig skyes pa rang rig pa'i ngo bo brtan par byas nas rang gi lce thog tu bzhag ces brjod la bdud rtsi myangs shing / btung ba rin chen 'di de ni/ /lus kyi rdo rje rab sgrub byed/ /bu khyod rtag tu shes gyur nas/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung shig /a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod cing myangs/ yum gyis kyang pad+ma nas bdud rtsi gnang bar bsams la/ bdud rtsi myangs shing / deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs rigs mthar skyes bud med rnams/ /pad+ma'i bha gar tsum+bha dang / /bdud rtsi rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod la myangs pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags/ gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyed par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi sgrib pa dag dpe zhing sa shin tu sbyangs pa la sa bon skyon med btab pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa dang / lam rtsa rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bag chags bzhag pas gsung rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/

/zhes brjod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyar la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dpa' bo 'bru lngas gdong g.yogs bcing / 'bru gsum gyis bsrung / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dpang por byas nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma gtad de spyi bor rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag bzhag par bsams la/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di de ni/ /brten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin/ /de bas 'khor ba sbyor bral nyid/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces gnang ba'i rig ma des dri ba mdzad par bsams la/ bshang gci la sogs za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /bud med gus mchod de bzhin du/ /bha ga nyid la 'o byed par/ bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ /ji ltar bde bar bus smos shig /zhes dris pa'i lan btab par bsams la/ bshang gci la sogs za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /bud med gus mchod de bzhin du/ /bha ga nyid la 'o byed par/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /zhes brjod pas gos dang bral ba'i chu skyes bsten te dri bzang gis byugs/ me tog gi phreng bas brgyan nas/ e ma nga yi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/

/bhañdza mo k+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsung zhing pang du byon par bsam/ rang 'khor lo bde mchog dang rig ma rdo rje phag mor gsal ba'i yum gyi lte bar oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang / snying khar oṃ hrī ha ha sogs dang / mgrin par oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni sogs dang / dpral bar oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs dang / yab kyi lte bar oṃ badz+ra bai ro sogs dang / snying khar oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs dang / mgrin par oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang / dpral bar oṃ hrī ha ha sogs dang / yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ nor bu dmar po byeṃ gyis mtshan pa zhes pa'i bar gong ltar las/ oṃ bi shi shi ha ha ha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms par zhugs pas rang dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum thams cad bkug ste lus la thim pas ro gcig tu gyur te spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dus pa rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba dbu ma'i lam nas 'khor lo bzhi brgyud pas yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas/ rdo rje nor bus rtse mor chags pa dang chags bral zung du chug rdo rje pad+mar rab bzhag nas/ /byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ /bskyod par byas na dga' ba des/ /sems bkang nas ni bsgom par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yi byang chub sems/ /ji srid 'byin par mi byed par/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun chad med/ /dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi rten gyur pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /phung po rnam shes brgyal ba la/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje kun sbyor dang / /reg byas kyis ni rmad byung che/ /bde ba bskyed par byed pa gang / /de ni mchog dga' byed pa'o/ /dga' bral dag gi dbus su ni/ /mtshon par ltos la brtan par gyis/ /pad+ma'i nam mkhar rdo rje yi/

/lte ba mnan pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du son bltas pa'i/ /ye shes skyes pa gang yin de/ /ye shes ngo bo shes pas brgyan/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong / /de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /mthun nam yang na nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal pa bskal pa stong dag tu/ /ye shes mngon 'byor gyis gnas bya/ /zhes brjod/ hūm̐ zhes gyen la drangs te lte bar dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ dpral bar dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ gtsug tor du lhan skyes brtan par bsam/ yum gyi phyag g.yon pa rang gi mgo la bzhag ste/ rjes gnang byin par bsams la/ de nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi lam bzhin du sems can gyi/ /don ni bdag nyid kun gyis shig /ces brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor sems kyi dri ma dag dpe myu gu skyes pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig bud med la mi smos pa dang / lam dngos dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten pa la dbang / chos kyi sku'i bag chags bzhag pas thugs rdo rje mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /zhes brjod/ bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul thal mo sbyar la/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol/ /'bru lngas gdong g.yogs bcing / 'bru gsum gyis bsrung / lus rnam snang gi 'dug stangs dang ldan pas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems kyi rnam rtog thams cad bcad nas don bsam pa ni/ yid med yid ni byas nas su/ /cung zad tsam yang bsam mi bya/ /bstan la gnas bcas bla ma yi/

/drin gyis yang dag sbyar bar bya/ /mkha' dang nam mkha' mnyam de bzhin/ /sems ni ro mnyam bsgom bya ste/ /bsam gtan 'dzin pa nges pas grol/ /rtog ge'i sbyor ba rnam par spang / /zhes gsung pa'i don ni/ yul gzugs sgra la sogs pa gang la yang mi 'jug par sngar gyi dpe'i ye shes kyi nyams myong tsam dran pa sngon du 'gro bas/ yin min dang yod med dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs la nam mkha'i khams stong pa nyid la nam mkha' dang nam mkha' ro mnyam pa de bzhin du sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid la sems dang stong pa ro mnyam pa so sor rang gi rig pa'i ting nge 'dzin nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par gzhag 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong / dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid kyi dri ma dag dpe 'bras bu yongs su smin pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshigs bsrung ba dang / lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang / ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bag chags bzhag pas ye shes rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /dam tshig bsdus te khas blang ba ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi dang mthun par brjod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /'khor lo bde mchog bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid bdag grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog

/gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de/ /'dod chags mchog gi dam tshig mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma phul/ bskang ba byed par spro na'ang bya/ slob ma dbang bskur bya dgos na mtshams sbyor zur pa bzhin bya'o/ /gzhug chog ni/ mchod pa kha gsos/ bsang sbyangs byin rlabs/ phyi nang gsang ba/ bstod pa'i mchod pa/ lhag chad kha skong / nongs pa bzod gsol/ rten yod med la brtan bzhugs skabs sbyar/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol ni/ rdul tshon gyi lha/ bum nang gi ye shes pa/ gtor mgron la byon pa'i rten med pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /sogs dang / badz+ra muḥ zhes pa'i mthar ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes dang / rdor dril rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid dran bzhin du/ a kā ro brjod cing dbang ldan gyi rtsigs pa dang por gshegs/ lha'i mtshan ma nas rang gi spyi bor cung zad bzhag rdo rje'i rtses phyogs bzhi nas ri mo 'then la mtha' nas bsdus/ thig rjes rnams dri bzang gi chus phye'o/

/de nas go bgo ba bsngo ba smon lam rnams sta gon bzhin byas la/ bkra shis ni/ bkra shis gang zhig yon tan kun gyi dpal mnga' ba/ /rdo rje 'chang dang grub chen dril bu pa la sogs/ /'phags bod mkhas grub rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la ni bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /bde chen zung 'jug thabs shes dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs/ /gar dgu sgyur sogs sna tshogs sprul sku he ru ka /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la ni༞ /bkra shis gang zhig chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin/ /zag med bde chen sgyu ma'i sku mnga' mkha' 'gro'i mchog /bde gshegs spro bsdu'i byed po rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la ni༞ /bkra shis gang zhig phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /mkha' 'gro la ma dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /las bzhi'i don mdzad dpa' mo'i dbang phyug khro chags sku/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la ni༞ /bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /rin chen bum pa pad+ma'i snod kyis spras pa'i nang / /ro bcud nus can ye shes bdud rtsi'i dngos grub stsol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la ni༞ /bkra shis gang zhig rgyal ba'i bsti gnas gzhal med khang / /rgya chen 'od gsal bkod legs dbyibs mdzes lta na sdug /byang phyogs chos dang tshad med bzhi sogs rang bzhin can/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la ni༞ /bkra shis gang zhig khor yug dur khrod brgyad rnams su/ /sna tshogs ro dang shing me sprin chu mchod rten bcas/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu dang grub pa sha zas bskor/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la ni༞ /bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa drwa gur/ /rdo rje'i bla res bres shing mda' yi drwa bar ldan/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i phreng bas yongs bskor ba/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la ni bkra shis shog
